title: Le Laude secondo la stampa fiorentina del 1490
summary: "Le Laude" by Jacopone da Todi is a collection of religious compositions written between the 12th and 15th centuries. These 92 lauds, written in ballad form, blend the popular Umbrian lauda tradition with the voice of a tormented soul. Jacopone violently attacks earthly reality for its vanity and transience, sometimes through passionate denunciation, other times through powerfully dramatic figures confronting divine mystery.
